edit my text to my sister, she has her anatomy lab practical next friday. warm but short. here's the draft:

"hey em bé, you've got this. you've been studying for weeks. also the $50 on the 1st is for actual groceries, not just textbooks, so please eat real food that week. try saying each structure out loud while pointing to it on yourself, and quiz with index cards in the shower lol. dont mention any of this to mom ok. proud of you"

keep the em bé as is

Here's a tighter version, with em bé kept exactly as you wrote it:

"hey em bé, you've got this. you've been studying for weeks 💛 Say each structure out loud while pointing to it on yourself, and quiz with index cards in the shower. Also, the $50 on the 1st is for real groceries, not just textbooks, so please eat a proper meal that week. Keep this between us, okay? Proud of you."

"hey em bé, you've got this, you've studied for weeks 💛
Say each structure out loud while pointing to it on yourself. And the $50 is for real groceries too, so eat a proper meal before the practical.
